I want to know! Did you use AI during the L.A. wildfires?

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/d…

Columbia Journalism Review (@CJR)

The LA Fires and what a disaster says about our physical and informational environments, by @Jon_Allsop. cjr.org/the_media_today/la_w…




— https://nitter.net/CJR/status/1878829345621659711#m

Matt Pearce 🦅🇺🇸 (@mattdpearce)

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…



— https://nitter.net/mattdpearce/status/1878607938547585212#m

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
As @mattdpearce.com kinda predicted the lofi media revolution is upon us, it's why I work at an organization expanding in AM radio

Being a 100% organic writer in the AI era is to want everyone to understand that if there’s something about my writing that’s boring or bad or cliche it’s actually because there’s something deeply inadequate about me as a person.

Every weekend, when I could be doing anything else, living life, getting tan, instead I hole up at a coffee shop,  not talking to anyone, pecking at my laptop with pigeonlike typing motions, and never once touch an AI feature because honestly I would probably rather kill myself. SKILL ISSUE

I need to read more Albert Hirschman!
mattdpearce.substack.com/p/how-to-thi...
Pynchon just rawdogging prose, no AI:
I bet that’s probably also Spencer Pratt’s problem.
We already have term limits but might be good to set screen time limits for our politicians too.
We all have that little voice that suggests slipping an office gold bar or two into our bag when leaving work, but adulthood is about resisting those temptations.
🚨 NEW: The Stop AI Strip Searches Act sponsored by @californialabor.bsky.social and the California Teamsters just PASSED the Assembly! 🚨

Grim but true...👇

"If there were a dictator of the internet who intentionally set out to destroy your ability to get accurate information, the result would look a lot like what’s already on your screen."

You couldn’t create a more anti-news internet if you tried www.niemanlab.org/2026/05/you-...

a weird news item that's lived in my head for ages was about people in a study wearing a belt that was 24/7 buzzing the direction of true north and the participants over time developing an intuitive, bird-like sense of direction. no idea why i'm thinking of this now when i want a hot dog for lunch
DON'T BELIEVE HIS LIES
(guy who barely knows what theory of mind means) it's giving theory of mind vibes
You couldn’t create a more anti-news internet if you tried www.niemanlab.org/2026/05/you-...

Super interesting piece by @mattdpearce.com on media through a behavioural economic lens. He provides no single solution but the whole thing does hint at ways that publishers might be able to nudge readers to be, uh, better.

www.niemanlab.org/2026/05/you-...
